high_level_description: The Clarth war hunters' camp on a floating snowy island: red hide tents on arched frames of sand shark bone around a giant shark skeleton, hunters in red cloaks and crested bone masks at cooking fires, a bone watchtower.

style_description.aesthetics: a lived in war camp seen from a little above, busy with small figures, warm against cold snow
style_description.lighting: warm sunlight from the upper right, short blue shadows falling to the lower left
style_description.art_style: crisp pixel art with clean dark outlines, flat shading in few colours, figures a few pixels tall

compositional_deconstruction.background: a floating island with a flat snowy top and blue ice cliffs, over a white sea of clouds, under a clear blue sky

elements.desc: a giant sand shark skeleton lying on the snow, its ribs hung with red hides
red hide tents stretched over arched frames of shark bone, smoke rising between them
hunters in red cloaks and crested bone war masks at small fires, jaw shields beside them
a tall watchtower of bone and red cloth with a lookout at the top
